  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The doc says the summary is "not printed when the run is killed by a signal", but the EXIT trap also runs after catchable signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT, SIGHUP).
  WHY: Only SIGKILL reliably skips the summary, so the wording is broader than the code supports. Severity is NIT in all sources.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_cycle_summary.py:35,43 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_script()` and `_helper_block()` re-read the roughly 34k-line poller on every call.
  WHY: This adds repeated file I/O across about 17 cases. Severity is NIT in all sources. Confidence ranged from 2 to 4.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_cycle_summary.py:128 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `bare_sleep` regex misses valid bare sleep forms such as `&& sleep`, `|| sleep`, `time sleep` and `if sleep 1; then`.
  WHY: A future sleep that bypasses the ledger would pass the test, and `sleep_ms` would undercount. Severity is NIT in all sources.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_cycle_summary.py | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `assert script.count(SLEEP_CALL) >= 2` is much weaker than the previous exact count of 11.
  WHY: Removing most ledger-routed sleep sites would not fail the count guard. Severity is NIT.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_cycle_summary.py | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `bare_sleep` scan is not heredoc-aware, so a Python heredoc body containing `sleep` could cause a false positive.
  WHY: A valid poller could fail the contract test. Severity is NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
